verdict.rationale: Groq's docs list newly released open-weight models like GPT-OSS-120B, and community reports (e.g., using Kimi K2 on Groq 'at the time' and Cerebras being 'a little slow on adding new models compared to groq') suggest Groq gets new open-weight models onto its platform relatively fast. However, there is no first-party statement or benchmark documenting release-to-availability latency, and only a couple of specific models are evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit vendor commitment/timeline on model onboarding speed, broader catalog evidence across many recent open-weight releases, and independent side-by-side timing data versus competitors.
